page.overview:
Who is Gigi?

Gigi is a major character in Lonely Freddy, the second story from Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch. She is Alec and Hazel's aunt who tries convincing her younger sister that their behavior is normal.

Gigi has no children and no desire for any, but is happy to give advice to her younger sister whenever she needs it. When Alec was ten, she suggested that Meg not single him out and that they switch to organic milk, having found studies that claimed the added hormones in regular dairy increased aggression in kids. Meg tells Gigi that Alec seems to be in his own world, but Gigi tries to offer an optimistic outlook and says Alec will be a great leader one day. Meg then tells Gigi she wants Alec to be more like a kid named Gavin, but Gigi finds his constant smile creepy and not desirable.

Just three days before Hazel's tenth birthday party, Gigi meets up with Meg, Alec, and Hazel at Freddy Fazbear’s Family Pizzeria. While Alec and Hazel play arcade games, Gigi joins Meg as she discusses plans for Hazel's party with a Party Prepper, unable to aid Meg in adding things to the package as she doesn't quite understand what Freddy's has to offer and is repulsed by the food. Eventually Meg asks Hazel if she wants to go into the Wind Tunnel for a chance to win a Yarg Foxy. Confused, Gigi asks what a Yarg Foxy is and the Party Prepper points towards the prize counter, explaining it can swing a hook. Gigi then asks about the Lonely Freddys, so the Party Prepper does a demo for it. Gigi makes a rude remark about unwanted kids and asks why the Yarg Foxy can't just be bought. When Alec kindly convinces Hazel to add the Wind Tunnel to her party, Gigi is shocked and asks if Meg switched to organic milk.

Back at Meg's house, Hazel continues to misbehave in front of Gigi and storms off to her room when Meg confronts her. Gigi brushes off Hazel's behavior as her just turning a certain age, then notices The Plan Planner. Gigi tells Meg that, while she thinks her and Ian are good parents, she wonders if their attempts to make Alec and Hazel "normal" have had the opposite effect. Meg snaps at her older sister then tells her she just wants to be a normal family. Gigi responds that Meg already is one.
